*schools and classrooms*
There were 8,284 usable classrooms in public pre-primary and primary schools in 2023/2024 (Sokoto State Annual School Census 23-24 Report, p. 92).
Of these, 2,511 were in need of major repairs, which was 30% of usable classrooms, and there were additional gaps of 5,170 classrooms with insufficient seating and 3,546 without a blackboard.
The plan target for 2027 is 11,697 usable pre-primary and primary classrooms (Education Sector 2025-2027 Medium-Term Sector Strategy (MTSS), p. 37), which is higher than the 8,284 recorded in 2023/2024.
---
*teachers*
At baseline in 2022 there were 3,806 teachers for pre-primary and primary education (Education Sector 2025-2027 Medium-Term Sector Strategy (MTSS), p. 37), with 94% qualified.
The outcome target for 2027 is 3,836 teachers, which is 30 teachers more than the 2022 baseline.
---
*funding and spending*
The approved budget for the State Universal Basic Education Board was ₦9.11 billion in 2025 (Sokoto State Government 2025 Approved Budget, p. 12) and ₦10.73 billion in 2026 (Sokoto State FY 2026 Budget, p. 18), with the 2026 amount representing 9.1% of the state's education allocation, calculated from the budget documents (Sokoto State FY 2026 Budget, p. 32).
Actual spending was 39.3% of the final budget in 2023, rising to 89.9% in 2024 (Budget Performance Report Q4 2024, p. 19) and then 47.7% in 2025 (Budget Implementation Report Q4 2025, p. 18), while in 2026 actual spending so far in Q1-Q3 was ₦524.16 million (Budget Implementation Report - 2026 Quarter 3, p. 17) against a revised budget of ₦10.73 billion (Budget Implementation Report Q2 2026, p. 17).
---
*enrolment and learning*
In 2021, 44.2% of children of primary school age were attending school (Nigeria 2021 Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) and National…, p. 298) and 53.2% were out of school.
For children of lower secondary school age, attendance was lower at 14.1% (Nigeria 2021 Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) and National…, p. 300) with 46.8% out of school.

turns: Waɗanne gundumomin Ƙaramar Hukumar Tambuwal ne ambaliya ta fi rufewa a 2026?
reply:
*Ambaliya: Ƙaramar Hukumar Tambuwal* — na gwaji

A gundumomin Ƙaramar Hukumar Tambuwal, kashin ƙasar da ruwan ambaliya ya rufe (radar) na 2026 ya tashi daga 0.0% (Tambuwal) zuwa 0.7% (Romo Sarki); matsakaici 0.0%. Mafi yawan ƙasa ƙarƙashin ruwa: Romo Sarki (0.7%), Bagida (0.1%), Sabon Birni (0.0%). Mafi ƙaranci: Tambuwal (0.0%), Sanyinna (0.0%), Jabo-Kagara (0.0%).

A 2026, radar ta ga hekta 110 na Ƙaramar Hukumar Tambuwal ƙarƙashin ruwa a wani lokaci (hekta 75 a gonaki, hekta 30 a fadamar kogi, hekta 4 a sauran ƙasa). Radar ta tauraron ɗan adam ta ga ruwan ambaliya a Ƙaramar Hukumar Tambuwal a kowace damina ta 2015–2026; mafi girma ita ce ta 2024, da hekta 4,060 ƙarƙashin ruwa a wani lokaci (hekta 3,270 a gonaki, hekta 550 a fadamar kogi, hekta 240 a sauran ƙasa). Taswirar UNOSAT ta 5–9 Satumba 2024 da 9–13 Nuwamba 2024, da aka haɗa daga kwanaki da dama, ta nuna hekta 8,040, kuma tana kama yawancin ambaliyar fiye da hotunan radar ɗaya-ɗaya. Radar ba za ta iya tantance kashi 42% na Ƙaramar Hukumar Tambuwal ba (gine-gine, bishiyoyi masu yawa, busasshen yashi); a can, rahotannin ambaliya ne madogara.

Madogara: radar ta Copernicus GFM, UNOSAT, JRC; cikakken bayani a nuna lissafi. Bayani ne kawai, ba gargaɗin ambaliya na hukuma ba.

Kuna so na wata gunduma ko ƙaramar hukuma?
